_comment: Unified single-file spec for sim_theorem_partii.py (model folded inline). k=3, diagonal-Gram case (G∞ = I_k). Market-like factor 1 β₁~N(1, sd 0.5), zero-mean unit factors 2,3 → c=[1.25,1,1]. factor_vols σ=[.16,.08,.06], idio vol 0.4 (δ²=.16). Effective spikes d_j = c_j·σ_j² = [0.032, 0.0064, 0.0036] satisfy Assumption 3 (strict decrease).
_factor_vols_note: factor_vols are volatilities (squared into F). σ = [0.16, 0.08, 0.06].
_beta_samplers_note: Per-factor loading samplers. Market-like factor 1 β₁~N(1, sd 0.5) (c₁=E[β₁²]=1²+0.5²=1.25); zero-mean unit factors 2,3 β_j~N(0,1) (c=1). Factors 2,3 zero-mean → off-diagonal Gram entries vanish, so G∞ stays diagonal. Prevalences c = [1.25, 1, 1].
_idio_note: idio_vol_sampler value is a volatility (squared into D). 0.4 → δ² = 0.16.
